options.name: remote_cluster
options.description: Remote cluster name, used to identify the selected remote cluster by name.

options.name: state
options.description: State defines the desired state of the VM replication - C(enabled), C(disabled), C(reenabled). Use C(enabled) for initial replication setup. Use C(disabled) to pause a configured replication. Use C(reenabled) to unpause a configured replication. I(remote_cluster) is optional in this case.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Virtual machine name. Used to identify selected virtual machine by name.
